meshConfig.additionalTypeDefs:
extend type Query {
  scandiwebMenu(identifier: String!, maxLevel: Int, storeCode: String): ScandiwebMenu
}

type ScandiwebMenu {
  menu_id: ID
  title: String
  is_active: Boolean
  css_class: String
  items: [ScandiwebMenuItem]
}

# FLAT BY DESIGN. API Mesh caps queryConfig.maxDepth at 6 and a recursive
# `children` field burns ~2 levels per menu tier, so a 3-level menu would sit at
# the cap. The EDS header block rebuilds the tree from parent_id + level.
type ScandiwebMenuItem {
  item_id: ID
  parent_id: ID
  level: Int
  position: Int
  title: String
  item_class: String
  icon: String
  url: String
  url_type: Int
  is_active: Boolean
  category_id: Int
  category_url_key: String
  cms_page_identifier: String
  advertisement: String
  advertisement_link: String
  advertisement_second: String
  advertisement_second_link: String
  custom_redirect: String
  is_promo: Int
  promo_image: String
  is_with_cms_block: Int
}
